How it works

Move ammonia. Make hydrogen onsite.

Ammonia carries hydrogen far more densely than compressed hydrogen. H3 converts it into high-purity hydrogen at the customer's site, at pressure, eliminating downstream mechanical compression and dramatically reducing hydrogen delivery movements.

Get the details
Four stages

One site.
Start to finish.

Ammonia delivery

Ammonia arrives through the bulk logistics that already serve industry.

On-site cracking

The H3 system converts ammonia into hydrogen and nitrogen at your site.

Purification

A membrane separates high-purity hydrogen from the remaining gas.

Point of use

Hydrogen leaves at pressure, ready for your process, with no downstream mechanical compression.

Ready for tomorrow

Green ammonia.
Same system.

As green ammonia becomes commercially available, customers can transition without replacing equipment or redesigning their processes.

Why ammonia

One ammonia tanker replaces twelve hydrogen tube trailers.

Global bulk ammonia logistics already exist: century-old infrastructure, not a future bet. H3 turns that existing supply chain into hydrogen, at the point of use.

Applications

Industrial hydrogen.
Without the tube-trailer cycle.

H3 installs, operates and maintains the system on your site. Commercial terms mirror familiar industrial-gas supply: fixed equipment rental, plus transparent molecule and delivery charges.
